high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a minimalist design. The room features light-colored walls and a large window that allows natural light to flood the space, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The floor is covered with a light-colored rug, which adds warmth to the otherwise neutral color palette. The furniture includes a wooden coffee table in the center of the room, surrounded by two armchairs and a sofa set. The armchairs and sofa have light-colored cushions, complementing the overall aesthetic.
